title: Tweet: the NGA tracks nonstructured light-energy craft

tellings.quote: National Geospatial Agency is able to keep track of all those nonstructured light energy craft flying around the world

Pretty nifty, how @NGA_GEOINT is able to keep track of all those non-structured light-energy craft flying around the world (go @Cardinals!). But they were lying to you when they said "we don't know how they work".

plain: A US intelligence agency that works with satellite and mapping imagery, the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency, is said to track "non-structured light-energy craft" flying around the world and to know how they work. The Pentagon whistleblower Matthew Brown reads this on the show from his own post on X, the social media site, of 6 June 2025, which says the agency "is able to keep track of all those non-structured light-energy craft flying around the world" and adds: "they were lying to you when they said 'we don't know how they work'."
